hypotheses.claim: safe_unpack accepts and creates FIFO special members because it rejects only absolute/traversal paths and symbolic or hard links.
hypotheses.distinguishing_observable: safe_unpack returns successfully and stat.S_ISFIFO is true for the extracted member.

hypotheses.claim: safe_unpack has no expanded-byte or compression-ratio ceiling.
hypotheses.distinguishing_observable: A small gzip tar expands a zero-filled member to at least 16 MiB in two bounded runs.

hypotheses.claim: Deep marker JSON is not converted to a typed rejection because RecursionError is not caught by either reader.
hypotheses.distinguishing_observable: Both prepare and docs readers raise RecursionError for a depth-1500 JSON value in two bounded runs.

hypotheses.claim: No single honest task-8-smoke marker satisfies both consumers because docs requires status=accepted while provenance resolution requires status=passed and additional top-level fields.
hypotheses.distinguishing_observable: The real accepted marker passes docs and fails provenance; toggling to a resolver-valid passed marker reverses the result.
